entities.name: 648-aa query protein
observations: Sequence-based analysis reports 648 aa, estimated molecular mass 70.9 kDa, theoretical pI 5.89, and GRAVY -0.0205.
Pfam scan detected EPSP_synthase PF00275 at residues 14–423 (i-Evalue 3.9e-121) and Cytidylate_kin PF02224 at residues 434–642 (i-Evalue 2.4e-73), with overlapping Cytidylate_kin2 PF13189 at 433–610.
Swiss-Prot similarity search returned homologs B3PJM0, Q3SK83, B3R368, Q8Y0Y6, and Q82TD4 at 64.6–67.4% identity over approximately 65.3–65.7% query coverage; annotation transfer was not accepted.
No explicit reaction, cofactor, pathway, localization, or oligomeric annotation was retrieved; functional assignment should remain provisional.

entities.name: EPSP_synthase PF00275
observations: Detected in query residues 14–423, i-Evalue 3.9e-121; domain call supports an EPSP-synthase-family N-terminal region but does not independently prove exact substrate specificity.

entities.name: Cytidylate_kinase PF02224
observations: Detected in query residues 434–642, i-Evalue 2.4e-73; family-level domain match supports a cytidylate-kinase-like C-terminal region.
